bf109.name: Messerschmitt Bf 109 G-14
bf109.role: German fighter, the G-14 version of 1944

combat.title: Air combat
combat.hint: You are at the controls facing a {{enemy}}: get behind it and keep it in the gunsight: every moment spent in the gunsight counts, and when the count is full your aircraft fires by itself and it is shot down, before time runs out.
combat.controls: Steer with the arrow keys or with the stick under the view. The pilot's head, in the middle of the instrument panel, turns toward the enemy.
combat.toast: Enemy fighters in sight: {{pilot}} can take the controls.

duel.toast: Enemy bomber in sight: {{pilot}} can attack.
duel.title: Bomber interception
duel.hint: You attack a {{enemy}} from behind. Play your {{moves}} moves: after the last one, the bomber is shot down if it is in your red firing cone, else it gets away.

maneuverHints.turnLeft: 1 cell ahead, then a quarter turn left
maneuverHints.turnRight: 1 cell ahead, then a quarter turn right

strafe.title: Ground attack
strafe.hint: You strafe a German convoy that drives toward you: get on its lane, and your aircraft fires by itself at what is ahead. Destroy {{required}} of {{total}} before it has gone by. Spare the Red Cross ambulance: destroying it fails the attack.
strafe.controls: Steer with the left and right arrow keys, or with the stick under the view.
strafe.toast: A German convoy on the road: {{pilot}} can strafe it.

photo.title: Photo reconnaissance
photo.hint: You fly over enemy ground: the camera of your aircraft takes by itself the target it keeps in its frame for a moment. Take {{required}} photos of {{total}} without being spotted: each tower you fly over raises the detection by {{percent}} %, and at 100 % you are spotted.
photo.controls: Steer with the left and right arrow keys, or with the stick under the view: the photo is taken by itself.
photo.toast: Enemy ground under the aircraft: {{pilot}} can photograph it.
photo.escaped: Reconnaissance failed: you were spotted, or photos are missing.

errors.invalidNickname: The nickname is 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts: try again in a quarter of an hour.
errors.invalidBody: Fill in the nickname and the password.

squadron.signInHint: Sign in to see your squadron.

welcome.title: Welcome, commander
welcome.text: Germany is attacking in the west. You command this air base and its squadron of D.520s. To hold the battle, shoot down 8 enemy aircraft; with no pilot or no aircraft left, it is lost. I will guide you through the first day.

launch.title: Step 1: a first mission
launch.text: Open the control tower (the gold arrow) and prepare a reconnaissance, the least risky: pick a pilot and an aircraft, then launch the mission.

fly.title: Step 2: the squadron is in flight
fly.text: The flight lasts a few minutes, in real time. At the control tower, watch the fatigue and stress of the pilots: a tired pilot flies worse.

receive.title: Step 3: the return
receive.text: The squadron is back: open the control tower and receive it, to read the report and collect the rewards.

maintenance.title: Step 4: the aircraft is damaged
maintenance.text: At the Hangar, inspect the aircraft to see its damage. If a module is destroyed, have the part made at the Workshop, then repair. An aircraft on fire explodes if it is not repaired in time.

free.title: Step 5: over to you
free.text: You have been through it all: missions, inspection, repair. To win you need 8 enemy aircraft shot down, which air combats bring. Rest your pilots, recruit, and improve the base with command points.

guide.here: The guide points at this building

reset.title: Start from scratch?
reset.text: This base is wiped: the squadron, the resources, the upgrades, the missions and the enemy aircraft shot down all start again from zero, and the tutorial is offered to you again. This cannot be undone.

choose.title: Choose your base
choose.hint: Each free site is a base to run; the other players of this world have taken theirs.

world.legend: Your camps are ringed in gold, your allies' in green, the enemy's are greyed, the free camps are in colour, red for the Axe. Point at a camp to see its name.
world.pick: Click a free camp on the map to put your base there.
world.landToClaim: To take a free camp, send an aircraft there from the Hangar: it is yours while one of your aircraft stands on it, and you can hold {{max}} at most.

won.title: Victory
won.text: The battle is won: {{target}} enemy aircraft shot down.

lost.title: Defeat
lost.text: There is no pilot or no aircraft left: the battle is lost.

hangar.unknownDamage: Damage unknown: the aircraft must be inspected before it is repaired.

event.explosionAlone: A burning {{aircraft}} exploded on the runway.
event.explosionKilled: A burning {{aircraft}} exploded on the runway; {{pilot}} is killed.
event.explosionSafe: A burning {{aircraft}} exploded on the runway; {{pilot}} gets out.
event.campTakenText: One of your aircraft landed at {{site}}: the camp is yours.
event.campLostText: None of your aircraft stands at {{site}} any more: you no longer hold this camp.

stationing.title: Station an aircraft
stationing.text: An aircraft and its pilot land at another camp, with fuel and ammunition for it, and stay there until you recall them. On a free camp, they take it for you while they are there. While they are away they do not fly, rest or get given.
stationing.nobodyFree: A free aircraft and a free pilot are needed.

guestPhase.stationed: On the ground at the camp

merchant.title: Merchant of the free camps
merchant.text: The free camps are run by the AI: it sells you fuel, ammunition and materials for supplies, and buys them back, up to {{max}} at a time. The scarcer a stock is at the camp, the dearer it is; it comes back to its level little by little.
